learning_outcomes.title: Power Rule for derivatives
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: d/dx xⁿ = n·xⁿ⁻¹.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: مشتقة xⁿ هي n·xⁿ⁻¹.

learning_outcomes.title: Product and Quotient Rules
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: (fg)′=f′g+fg′; (f/g)′=(f′g−fg′)/g².
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: (fg)′=f′g+fg′؛ (f/g)′=(f′g−fg′)/g².

learning_outcomes.title: Chain Rule
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: (f(g(x)))′ = f′(g(x))·g′(x): differentiate the outside, keep the inside, multiply by the derivative of the inside.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: (f(g(x)))′ = f′(g(x))·g′(x): اشتق الخارجية واترك الداخلية واضرب في مشتقة الداخلية.

learning_outcomes.title: Derivative of an inverse function
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: (f⁻¹)′(b) = 1 / f′(a) where f(a)=b.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: (f⁻¹)′(b) = 1 / f′(a) حيث f(a)=b.

learning_outcomes.title: Trigonometric derivatives
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: (sin x)′=cos x, (cos x)′=−sin x, (tan x)′=sec²x.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: (sin x)′=cos x و(cos x)′=−sin x و(tan x)′=sec²x.

learning_outcomes.title: Exponential derivatives
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: (eˣ)′=eˣ; (aˣ)′=aˣ ln a.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: (eˣ)′=eˣ؛ و(aˣ)′=aˣ ln a.

learning_outcomes.title: Natural logarithmic derivatives
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: (ln x)′=1/x؛ و(ln u)′=u′/u.

learning_outcomes.title: Implicit differentiation
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Differentiate both sides with respect to x, treat y as y(x) (multiply by dy/dx), then solve for dy/dx.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اشتق الطرفين بالنسبة إلى x واعتبر y دالة في x (اضرب في dy/dx) ثم حل لإيجاد dy/dx.

learning_outcomes.title: Hypotheses of Rolle’s Theorem
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Rolle: f continuous on [a,b], differentiable on (a,b), f(a)=f(b) ⇒ f′(c)=0 for some c.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: رول: f متصلة على [a,b] وقابلة للاشتقاق على (a,b) وf(a)=f(b) فيوجد c يحقق f′(c)=0.

learning_outcomes.title: Continuity: definition and applications
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Choose constants so that the left limit, right limit and the value at the join are equal.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اختر الثوابت بحيث تتساوى النهاية من اليسار واليمين وقيمة الدالة عند نقطة الوصل.

learning_outcomes.title: Horizontal, vertical and oblique asymptotes
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Vertical: zero of the denominator; horizontal/oblique: compare degrees at infinity.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: الرأسي: صفر المقام؛ الأفقي/المائل: قارن الدرجات عند ∞.

learning_outcomes.title: Product Rule
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: (fg)′ = f′g + fg′. Simplify the result and evaluate at the requested point.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: (fg)′ = f′g + fg′. بسّط الناتج ثم عوّض عند النقطة المطلوبة.

learning_outcomes.title: Derivatives of trigonometric functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Combine trig derivatives with product/quotient/chain rules; tangent line: y−f(a)=f′(a)(x−a).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اجمع مشتقات الدوال المثلثية مع قواعد الضرب والقسمة والسلسلة؛ المماس: y−f(a)=f′(a)(x−a).

learning_outcomes.title: Applications of exponential and logarithmic derivatives
learning_outcomes.statement: Applications of exponential and logarithmic derivatives
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Differentiate the model, then interpret f′(a) as the instantaneous rate of change with units.
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: اشتق النموذج ثم فسّر f′(a) معدل تغير لحظياً مع الوحدة.

learning_outcomes.title: Mean Value Theorem
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: MVT: f′(c) = (f(b)−f(a))/(b−a) for some c in (a,b) when f is continuous on [a,b] and differentiable on (a,b).
learning_outcomes.rule_ar: نظرية القيمة المتوسطة: f′(c) = (f(b)−f(a))/(b−a) لبعض c في (a,b) إذا كانت f متصلة على [a,b] وقابلة للاشتقاق على (a,b).
